modules.name: Verified launch boundary
modules.authorityModel: Only the immutable LBPStrategy address may initialize the one bound pool.
modules.humanSummary: Creates a fixed-supply token through the official factory, sells it through the official auction path, then initializes one precommitted Uniswap v4 pool.
invariants: The token cannot mint again.
Only the configured launch strategy can initialize the pool.
The hook cannot be reused for a different pool configuration.
Creation and transfer into the launch path must be atomic.

modules.name: Fixed platform fee
modules.authorityModel: No admin. Anyone may trigger collection, but funds can only reach the immutable fee recipient.
modules.humanSummary: Charges 0.10% of the absolute unspecified amount of each completed swap and accumulates it as PoolManager claims.
invariants: The fee rate cannot change.
The payout address cannot change.
No caller can redirect accrued fees.
The hook does not alter the specified swap amount before execution.

modules.name: Direct liquidity boundary
modules.authorityModel: Only the immutable DirectLiquidityLauncherV1 address may initialize the one bound pool.
modules.humanSummary: Creates a fixed-supply token and atomically opens one full-range Uniswap v4 position using creator-supplied ETH and tokens.
invariants: Token creation, hook deployment, pool initialization and position minting are atomic.
Only the configured direct launcher can initialize the pool.
The position is minted directly to the deterministic locked fee forwarder.
Matching factory-recorded CREATE2 artifacts can be reused, while unrecognized deployments are rejected.
Unused liquidity budgets and remaining token supply return to the launch creator.
The launch contract retains no token balance after a successful launch.

modules.name: Locked initial liquidity
modules.authorityModel: The official Uniswap position forwarder owns the LP NFT. No creator, platform administrator or operator can transfer it or remove initial liquidity.
modules.humanSummary: Locks the initial LP position while allowing anyone to forward accrued LP fees to the immutable launch creator.
invariants: The position recipient is deployed by Launcher’s deterministic forwarder factory.
The transfer operator is the zero address.
The approval timelock is the maximum uint256 block.
Collecting fees uses a zero-liquidity decrease and cannot reduce principal.
LP fees go to the launch creator while Launcher hook fees go only to the platform treasury.

modules.name: Dynamic LP fee
modules.humanSummary: Reserved for a separately audited hook family.
invariants: Must not be presented as compatible with Verified Standard V1.

modules.name: Oracle-aware behavior
modules.humanSummary: Reserved for a separately audited hook family with explicit oracle failure handling.
invariants: Must not be presented as compatible with Verified Standard V1.

modules.name: External custom hook
modules.authorityModel: Defined by the external hook author.
modules.humanSummary: A future permissionless path that must be isolated from verified launches and clearly expose its risk.
invariants: Must never inherit the verified badge.
Must display bytecode, permissions, source verification, audit status and mutable authorities.
Must not be able to impersonate a Launcher-owned hook family.
